Talent0_2Ability.name: Prototype
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: If you cast a One-Handed Machine Gun skill during an Active Attack, use the opposite arm to launch <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> after the enemy's Retaliation, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Prototype
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat with a One-Handed Machine Gun skill, uses the opposite arm to launch <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> after the enemy retaliates, dealing <color=#F74848>0.25x</color> DMG. Machine Gun Weight <color=#F74848>-80</color>.

200001.name: CEC 1
200001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, use Assault Weapons to launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

700036.name: Hasta Manana
700036.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.

200803.name: Flames of War
200803.describe: Uses two Machine Guns to attack all targets within a <range type=1>3x2-tile area ahead</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.35x</color> AoE DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times.

200804.name: One Mech Army
200804.describe: Simultaneously uses two Machine Guns to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.7x</color> DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times. After combat, repairs undestroyed parts, restoring HP equal to <color=#F74848>40%</color> of damage dealt.

200805.name: Superconductivity
200805.SpecificEffects: Rail Gun DMG <color=#F74848>+20%</color>. Automatically loads <color=#F74848>1</color> Ammo every <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

200806.name: Purge
200806.describe: Consumes <color=#F74848>2</color> rounds of Ammo. Uses a Rail Gun to attack all targets within a <range type=1>3x5-tile area</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>1.0x</color> AoE DMG.

200807.name: Power Disparity
200807.SpecificEffects: For every <color=#F74848>10%</color> HP the target has lost, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

200808.name: Unstoppable
200808.describe: Simultaneously uses two Machine Guns to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.95x</color> DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times.

200809.name: Ballistic Bundle
200809.describe: Uses a Machine Gun to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.3x</color> DMG.

200011.name: CEC 2
200011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

200021.name: CEC 3
200021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

200022.name: Power Innovation 2
200022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

200031.name: Perfect Position 1
200031.SpecificEffects: Unlock the Assault Weapon's <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf> ability. When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, final DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

200033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
200033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if an Active Attack was not initiated this turn, an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

200034.name: Perfect Position 2
200034.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+12%</color>.

200035.name: Perfect Position 3
200035.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+12%</color>.

200036.name: Perfect Position 4
200036.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, final DMG <color=#F74848>+30%</color>.

200043.name: Adaptive Warfare 2
200043.SpecificEffects:
Before actively attacking without having moved, can trigger <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking. Only triggers if no other [Re-ATK] effect is triggered this turn.
Effects similar to <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> cannot be re-triggered.

200845.name: Dominate Field 3
200845.SpecificEffects: After an Active Attack in combat, automatically use a Rail Gun to launch <buf ID=900031>[Extra Strike]</buf> once against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG without consuming any Ammo.

200846.name: Dominate Field 4
200846.SpecificEffects: When launching <buf ID=900031>[Extra Strike]</buf>, if the target is within the cross area, deals <color=#F74848>0.3x</color> AoE DMG to all targets within a Line (<color=#F74848>5</color> tiles) in which the target is located.
